open_points.subject: 01_models.md:Model M29 — OwnerFormField source of truth
open_points.text:
The release: the data provider's owner form table. The generated code reads
the table, so a constant of the data provider delivers it
open_points.question: Which exact data-provider constant is the authoritative owner form table from which OwnerFormField values are created?
options: A differently named dedicated owner-form constant
Another provider constant selected or derived later

witness.initial: A data-provider release exposes `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS` and another plausible owner-form-related constant with different rows.
events: A later agent implements M29 and binds the generated reader to `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`.
Another later agent implements M29 and binds the generated reader to the other constant because State 1 names only “a constant”.
outcomes: The generated owner page and reader recognize the rows in `OWNER_FORM_FIELDS`.
The generated owner page and reader recognize a different set of rows.
witness.observer: The owner, whose form fields are written or read differently.
